active_work_item.title: Real quote intake UI + client state
active_work_item.depends_on: CP12-01 independently QA-passed and merged; owner testing exposed inert quote controls and fixture-only journey
active_work_item.reason: Owner acceptance testing proved the commercial milestone was not actually complete: Quote 1/2/3 are inert placeholders and real PDF/image inputs are not wired. CP13 closes the real-user journey gap. CP13-01 is the smallest bounded GREEN slice: genuine file/pasted-text selection state with remove/replace, 2-input gating, mobile/accessibility coverage, and explicit prevention of fixture substitution.

commercial_milestone: Owner can personally select/upload 2-3 real quotes, receive a useful preview, unlock a complete report, and receive grounded analysis derived from those exact inputs without fabricated findings

save_game.verified_behavior: CP0-CP12 implementation is merged and prior deterministic QA gates passed, including launch education, grounded report/trust contracts, CA$14.99 mock access boundary, print/PDF and PWA metadata. Owner testing subsequently established that real quote intake/end-to-end analysis is not implemented.
save_game.risks: The launch surface currently overstates practical readiness because Quote controls are inert and the page remains fixture-only. CP13 must not hide this with demo substitution. Two moderate test-only Vitest/@vitest-mocker findings remain documented. Production deployment/live payments/storage/providers/secrets/DNS/customer communication/ads remain RED.
save_game.rollback: Return to CP12 merged SHA a3a72d57a41a6153e80f3ad1d83ab2c430320991 if CP13 introduces journey, trust, access, privacy or presentation regressions.

human_gate.when: After CP13 real intake, extraction, analysis wiring, generated report binding and end-to-end regression independently QA-pass
human_gate.required: Owner personally selects/uploads at least two real quotes, clicks Analyze, and confirms the resulting grounded report is based on those exact inputs before CP13/commercial milestone may be marked complete.
